source_text: The Canadian Paediatric Society (CPS), in its 2015 position statement, concludes that the health benefits of newborn circumcision—primarily reduced risk of urinary tract infections and certain sexually transmitted infections—do not outweigh the risks, including procedural pain, bleeding, and potential complications, and thus does not endorse routine circumcision for all male newborns. [113]
